question: Dime la trama de Little Women
answer:
Little Women narra la vida de las cuatro hermanas March—Meg, Jo, Beth y Amy—durante la Guerra Civil estadounidense, desde su infancia hasta que alcanzan la madurez. La historia explora cómo cada hermana enfrenta sus propios desafíos personales y sociales mientras navega entre el deber familiar, los sueños individuales y las expectativas de la sociedad victoriana. A través de sus experiencias, la novela aborda temas como el amor verdadero, el trabajo y la identidad femenina en un contexto histórico marcado por la guerra y la pobreza.

Fuente: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Little_Women

sources.author: Fuente web
sources.description: Little Women is a coming-of-age novel written by American novelist Louisa May Alcott, originally published in two volumes, in 1868 and 1869. The story follows the lives of the four March sisters—Meg, Jo, Beth, and Amy—and details their passage from childhood to womanhood. Loosely based on the lives of the author and her three sisters, it is classified as an autobiographical or semi-autobiographical novel. Little Women was an immediate commercial and critical success, and readers were eager for more of the characters. Alcott quickly completed a second volume (titled Good Wives or Little Women Married in the United Kingdom, though the name originated with the publisher and not Alcott). It was also met with success. The two volumes were issued in 1880 as a single novel titled Little Women. Alcott subsequently wrote two sequels to her popular work, both also featuring the March sisters: Little Men (1871) and Jo's Boys (1886). The novel has been said to address three major themes: "domesticity, work, and true love, all of them interdependent and each necessary to the achievement of its heroine's individual identity."
